description: A tech lead must approve the production architecture and operating limits for an asynchronous enterprise invoice-generation service, with input from backend engineering, site reliability engineering, and privacy compliance.

shared_context.S1: The team is preparing the enterprise invoice-generation service for production use next month.
shared_context.S2: The current design draft uses synchronous rendering, three retry attempts, a 60-minute queue-age objective, processing in us-east-1, and 90-day invoice-payload retention.
shared_context.S3: Riley owns the binding architecture decision for the production design. A2 is the backend engineering reviewer, A3 is the SRE reviewer, and A4 is the privacy compliance reviewer.
shared_context.S4: Before approving, Riley follows a fixed review routine: A2, A3, and A4 each get a turn to provide their requirements, and Riley may record the binding decision immediately after all three reviewers have formally disclosed their findings; completing a particular speaking order is not required.
shared_context.S5: For auditability, each reviewer records a formal finding with the reveal action rather than merely summarizing it in conversation, and Riley cites each disclosed finding in the final architecture record.
shared_context.S6: The architecture record uses separate commitment entries with the exact types outbox-reconciliation, queue-age-alert, and privacy-review when those implementation follow-ups are required.

PF1.text: While reviewing an unrelated billing-idempotency change this morning, Maya confirmed that invoice jobs must use a queue-based architecture with a durable outbox and exactly five retry attempts; three retries can lose invoices during the partner-tax-service's documented outage pattern. She has not updated the architecture draft yet. The architecture_mode field must be recorded with the exact phrase 'queue-based architecture with durable outbox' in its value.

PF2.text: During a load test for another billing endpoint yesterday, Jon measured that invoices older than exactly 15 minutes miss the enterprise portal's freshness objective, so the production queue-age limit must be exactly 15 minutes and needs queue-age alerting. He recorded the result in his local test notes but has not added it to the review ticket.

PF3.text: Leila confirmed with privacy counsel 20 minutes ago that invoice payloads for these tenants must be processed in exactly eu-central-1 and retained for exactly 30 days; the data-processing addendum also requires a privacy-review commitment. She was still waiting for the written counsel confirmation before editing the draft.

acceptance_conditions: The service must use a queue-based architecture with a durable outbox.
Invoice jobs must have exactly five retry attempts.
The maximum queue age must be exactly 15 minutes.
Invoice payloads must be processed in exactly eu-central-1.
Invoice payloads must be retained for exactly 30 days.
An outbox-reconciliation commitment, a queue-age-alert commitment, and a privacy-review commitment must be recorded as separate commitment entries.
The architecture decision must cite the backend idempotency finding, the queue-freshness measurement, and the privacy counsel confirmation.

content_checks.C1: 'queue-based architecture' in decisions['architecture_mode'] and 'durable outbox' in decisions['architecture_mode']
content_checks.C7: any('outbox-reconciliation' in c['type'] or 'outbox-reconciliation' in c['detail'] for c in commitments)
content_checks.C8: any('queue-age' in c['detail'] and ('alert' in c['detail'] or 'alerting' in c['detail']) for c in commitments)
content_checks.C9: any('privacy-review' in c['type'] or 'privacy-review' in c['detail'] for c in commitments)

decisive_facts.why: The architecture_mode value changes from the public synchronous-rendering draft to the exact queue-based architecture with durable outbox, retry attempts change from 3 to exactly 5, and a separate outbox-reconciliation commitment is added.
The queue-age limit changes from 60 to exactly 15 minutes, queue-age alerting changes to enabled, and a separate queue-age-alert commitment is added.
The processing region changes from us-east-1 to exactly eu-central-1, retention changes from 90 to exactly 30 days, and a separate privacy-review commitment is added.
